epithet: of the Gold Dragonborn, born to breath and blade
constellation_epithet: ever in the press, the steadiest hand
distinction_subtitle: whose single night turned five crit successes
distinction_detail: 5 crit successes in one session · the brightest single night the table has seen

archetype_badge.inscription: Ten days of rations and a full waterskin ride behind his saddle, because a dragonborn lord never lets his own host go hungry before the battle starts.

sworn_creed: sworn to crown and company, his call steadies the line when others break

epithet: of the Rock Gnomes, who answers a crowd with a clap of thunder
constellation_epithet: most foes felled from the fewest throws
distinction_subtitle: who felled twelve foes in one session, three times any other hand's best
distinction_detail: 12 kills in a single session · no other hand has claimed more than 4 in a night

archetype_badge.inscription: She keeps three dozen Ohelo berries against the small hurts, and one vial of true healing saved only for the wound that finally frightens her.

sworn_creed: force bent to her reading of the weave, and spared before it reaches her allies

epithet: of the Dhakaani, bound by pact to a shadow unseen
constellation_epithet: few throws, and great weight in them
distinction_subtitle: who has brought down more kinds of creature than any other hand
distinction_detail: 9 creature types felled · the broadest range of foes in the company

archetype_badge.inscription: Fifteen flasks of oil weigh down his pack, kept steady for the one lamp he lights when the shadow at his shoulder goes quiet and the tunnels close in.

sworn_creed: a devil holds his signature in blood, and its fire answers when he calls

epithet: of the Tabaxi, who lets the bowstring do all her speaking
constellation_epithet: ever at the hunt, the soft-pawed shot
distinction_subtitle: who poured a healing potion into Urida when the naga's lightning dropped her
distinction_detail: Session 30 · Urida, felled by the spirit naga's lightning bolt, brought back to her feet

archetype_badge.inscription: A sprig of mistletoe rides on her belt, tied with ribbon, and she reads the trail through it long before she lets an arrow fly.

distinction_basis.note: revived Urida with a healing potion during the spirit naga fight

sworn_creed: she crossed once into the feywild, and it never fully let her walk back out

epithet: of the Wulven, who takes up whatever weapon the moment puts in reach
reliquary_header: Felled by whatever came to hand
constellation_epithet: the busiest hand, and richly paid for it
distinction_subtitle: whose single strike has landed harder than any other in the company
distinction_detail: 69 damage in a single blow · the hardest hit any hand has struck
sworn_creed: a second self hunts beside him, a blow struck from where he is not

archetype_badge.inscription: A 25-pound hunting trap waits in Grieg's pack for the day a beast needs catching instead of killing, one more weight a beast hunter carries just in case.
